$comment: The wire format shared by the Bazaar Utils website and the Bazaar Utils mod.
These values are duplicated by necessity: the website declares them as Zod
schemas, the mod as Java records and constants, and neither can import the
other. This file is the single written-down copy, and lib/minecraft/contract.test.ts
asserts the website's schemas still agree with it. A change here is a protocol
change and needs a matching change in mkram17/Bazaar-Utils.
normalizeLinkCode must agree character for character on both sides: the
normalized code IS the serverId nonce the mod passes to joinServer and the
website passes to hasJoined, so any divergence turns every link attempt into a
silent verification failure rather than a visible error.
